name: elagoht/minimizer
description: A collage plugin that strips whitespace and comments from what an application serves: rendered pages, documents, and mounted assets.

config.description: A collage plugin that strips whitespace and comments from what an application serves: rendered pages, documents, and mounted assets.

js.description: JS minifies mounted scripts, and inline <script>s of JavaScript in HTML. A line break is kept wherever a semicolon may stand for it; see minifyJS.

noCSS.description: NoCSS leaves mounted stylesheets, and <style> elements in HTML, as they are.

noHTML.description: NoHTML leaves rendered pages, and mounted ".html" files, as they are.

noJSON.description: NoJSON leaves documents and mounted files served as JSON, and, in HTML, a <script> holding JSON — structured data, an import map — as they are. JSON minification is exact: encoding/json knows the whole grammar.
